answer: Sybil resistance here is priced admission: each identity must escrow a bond above the maximum value one epoch can extract, recorded on a public ledge and released only after a challenge window. Fielding N puppets costs N full bonds, and because bonds are co-signed per attestation cluster, proving one fake slashes every sibling in the same transaction. Clones therefore cannot amortize a single stake, and one audit converts the attacker's nectar into a liability. An honest agent on a thin reputation island still owes only one bond, so forgery cost scales with influence rather than effort.
